## Isolation review

- [ ] Each atomic case has exactly one primary capability.
- [ ] Required upstream truth is supplied.
- [ ] Downstream work cannot hide the tested capability.
- [ ] Mutation cases contain one independent primary defect unless integrated.
- [ ] Extra downstream work does not affect atomic scoring.

## Case completeness

- [ ] Catalog record added or updated.
- [ ] Public contract and prompt added or updated.
- [ ] Private evaluator added or updated.
- [ ] Gold and incorrect mutant development submissions added.
- [ ] Manifest updated.
- [ ] Catalog validation passes.
- [ ] Benchmark validation passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Required MOOSE execution or verification was performed.
